en: Illustrated postcard combining a lively fairground scene with a small colored inset view of a European town square. The main illustration, mostly in monochrome, shows people at a fair with a puppet booth labeled "Kasperl-Theater," children and adults walking, and people sitting at tables. The inset image is a colored view of a central square surrounded by multi‑story buildings with red roofs, a fountain or monument in the middle, market stalls with umbrellas, and a hill in the background topped by a clock tower and fortification. German text at the top and on the inset identifies the scene as Graz and mentions the autumn fair.
